Incorporating the Financial Stability Report (FSR) perspective, the statement’s “solid pace” of activity and a 25 bp cut point to a mildly positive macro tone, but the FSR tempers that optimism. The September 2024 FSR highlights mixed but generally resilient financial conditions: bank capital and liquidity remain above pre-pandemic levels with reduced reliance on uninsured deposits, yet banks have tightened lending standards, some runnable short-term funding has increased, and vulnerabilities persist in areas like elevated valuations and commercial real estate. The Fed is also monitoring fiscal sustainability and geopolitical risks. Coupled with ongoing QT and money market facilities set at the floor to maintain tight operational control, the overall stance is balanced with a cautious tilt. Net: slightly positive but more constrained than a pure growth read.
